items.title: Did Bell–Cisco Sovereign AI Pact Just Recast Cisco Systems' (CSCO) Regulated-Market Strategy?
items.summary: In late September 2026, Bell Canada and Cisco announced a memorandum of understanding to build a sovereign AI infrastructure platform in Canada, combining Bell’s domestic data centres and networks with Cisco’s AI, security, observability, and Sovereign Critical Infrastructure technologies for customers with strict data residency and control needs. This move highlights how Cisco is trying to embed its AI-focused networking, security, and infrastructure stack into regulated markets where...

items.title: The One Number Cisco Stock Investors Should Watch
items.summary: You probably think of Cisco Systems (CSCO) as an AI stock, a supplier of AI infrastructure to the hyperscalers. That business was only about 6% of Cisco's revenue in fiscal 2026. The rest includes networking and security products sold to enterprises and telcos. Cisco stock returned 61% over the past year. With AI that small a share of revenue, you are paying for growth across the whole company. How fast is Cisco's business outside AI set to grow.

items.title: The Dividend Stock I’m Adding Before October
items.summary: A pullback just handed income investors a lower entry price than Cisco paid for its own shares, and the October record date is closing fast. Here is why this AI networking play keeps beating consumer staples for a dividend portfolio built around a rising quarterly check.

items.title: How To Create Income From Arista Networks Stock
items.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) stock costs 63.2 times earnings, against 21.9 for the S&P 500. You can be paid now to agree to buy the shares at a much lower price. So how much income can you earn this way, and would you be glad to own Arista at that price.

items.title: These Nasdaq 100 Stocks Are Quietly Paying Real Dividends
items.summary: Most investors write off the Nasdaq-100 as a dividend wasteland, but a handful of its chip and networking giants have been quietly raising their payouts every single year while competitors chase hype cycles.

items.title: What Are Dell Stock Investors Overlooking?
items.summary: The number Dell Technologies (DELL) holders should watch most closely is its AI server revenue. Dell expects $74 billion from these servers in fiscal 2027, three times the year before. The stock returned 320% in the last twelve months, against 17.7% for the S&P 500. News reports tie Dell's rally in 2026 to its rise as one of the top sellers of Nvidia-based servers. So what might Dell stock investors be overlooking.

items.title: What Could Surprise Cisco Stock Investors On The Upside?
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock returned 62% over the past 12 months (as of Ssptember 28, 2026). After that run, you pay 31.8 times its past year's earnings, against 22.1 for the S&P 500. At that price, the stock appears to assume growth that has not happened yet, so further upside would need something beyond that. So what could still surprise Cisco Systems investors on the upside.
